title: Electric Circuits
summary: Cells, bulbs, LEDs and switches: what makes a circuit complete, circuit symbols, and series vs parallel.

ib.note: Current, voltage and Ohm’s law are MYP 4–5 / CBSE 10

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 3: Electricity: Circuits and their Components

objectives: I can build a complete circuit and explain why current needs a closed path.
I can draw and interpret circuit diagrams using standard symbols.
I can explain how cells, switches and LEDs affect a circuit, and compare series and parallel bulbs.
misconceptions: Current is used up by the bulb.
Only one wire is needed from the cell to the bulb.
An LED works either way round.
